name: Mijares (Spain)
description: Square flag divided horizontally red over white, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Mijares (a bridge inscribed MDCLXXIX above waves on blue).
history: The arms and the flag were approved officially on 4 April 2001 (Boletín Oficial de Castilla y León no. 106 of 1 June 2001); the flag is square of 1:1, red and white divided horizontally, with the municipal arms in its colours at the centre.

features.role: Mijares arms — bridge above waves on blue
